answer.rationale: Prioritize a targeted SMB onboarding simplification response: it has confirmed SMB evidence of higher signup (+15%), activation (+9%), and qualified revenue (+4%), with only a small observed 30-day retention decline (-1%). Do not counter the competitor primarily with promotional pricing: the directly relevant 40% price-sensitive SMB discount drove acquisition and short-term qualified revenue but produced -12% 30-day retention and failed to survive the first renewal cycle, creating material long-term value risk. Run a standard, guarded SMB experiment and monitor retention, renewal intent, and qualified revenue alongside activation; evidence does not establish that simplification alone will fully offset competitor-driven price churn.
